verdict.rationale: Ollama's marketing emphasizes that local runs 'never leave your machine' and prompts are 'never tracked or trained on,' implying a privacy-by-default posture, but there is no explicit documentation of a telemetry system, what data (if any) is collected, or a concrete opt-out flag/setting. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking disclosure, a documented opt-out mechanism (env var, config flag), and independent confirmation that no background telemetry is sent.
